title: Reference approach: Loss Comparison
answer: Implement loss comparison in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: MSELoss, CrossEntropyLoss. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 058. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
reg = nn.MSELoss()(torch.tensor([[2.]]), torch.tensor([[1.]])); cls = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(torch.tensor([[2., 1.]]), torch.tensor([0]))
print(round(reg.item(), 3), cls.ndim)
